text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
This document outlines the inspection activities as indicated by I1 in the above
title block to be performed on annual base Y1. The first draft initiated 
at Demo substation, eng Abdel Tawab Ramadan. The first review at Nov 2007.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with cautions marks surrounding the work area
CB must be
 isolated and proper earthingat on the two sides of CB is required.
Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)
Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.
Tools and Equipments
Safety equipment "belt,
 shoes,...,etc".
Work to be Carried Out
Inspect top end of oil dash pot (58) through inspection window. If traces of
 oil are present on oil dash pot. remove and recondition as following:
 1- Remove side cover of operating mechanism.
 2- Remove oil dash pot and strip down.
Measure 
 the gas pressure with plug-in manometer and compare with gas pressure
 characteristic top-up SF6 gas if pressure has sunk to almost the refill
 pressure.
Check the gas moisture content of SF6 gas and compare with the permissible
 moisture content limits (see table).
Repeat the
 above steps for remaining two poles.
